English Language.question: 1) If we ______ enough money, we would have bought the property.
English Language.exp:
This the example of past unreal condition.
Since the main clause has ‘would have + past participle’ so, the subordinate clause must have ‘had+ past participle’.
So the correct answer is ‘had had’.

English Language.question: 2) The sooner you finish your studies, _____ you will be allowed to play!
English Language.exp: The + Comparative _____, The + comparative. Both options ‘The faster , and ‘the sooner’ meet the condition but the sooner make more sense to the sentence.

English Language.question: 3) Our school record for employability is very good: by the time, the students have completed their graduation, ______ by national and multinational companies.
English Language.option2: খ) they had all been offered employment
English Language.option3: গ) all they had offered employment
English Language.option4: ঘ) they have all been offered
English Language.exp:
The sentence described a general fact so the answer should be in simple present tense.
So, the answer is 'they all have employment'.

English Language.question: 4) A series of complicated steps ------- to complete the project.
English Language.exp:
A series is the subject and it is singular so was needed is the answer.
Note that the sentence is in passive voice.

English Language.question: 5) Though _____ toward his own needs, he was always _____ toward others.
English Language.exp:
Since subordinate clause start with though so, the meaning of the clauses contrast to each other.
Only option A has a contrasted pair.

English Language.question: 6) The bag of seeds _____ open.
English Language.exp:
The sentence is in passive nature, the subject is singular and the right form of past participle of silt is silt, not slitted.
So, the appropriate answer is ‘was slit’.

English Language.question: 7) The father clearly _____ as his little one threw a tantrum inside the toy store.
English Language.exp:
The sentence is in passive nature and the right form of past participle of abashed is abashed.
So, the appropriate answer is ‘was abashed’.

English Language.question: 8) It was expected that _____ his plane landed, his fans _____ mad with excitement.
English Language.option1: ক) as soon as, would go
English Language.option3: গ) no sooner had, had gone
English Language.exp:
- No sooner has is a wrong phrase so option D is omitted,
- ’No sooner had’ takes conjunction than but there is no conjunction ‘than’ so option C is omitted.
- So, B is the most appropriate answer.

English Language.question: 9) The papers are to be prepared _____ this month.
English Language.exp:
একটি নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে বুঝাতে preposition ‘within’ বসে।
বাক্যের অর্থঃ একমাসের মধ্যে রিপোর্ট প্রস্তুত করতে হবে।

English Language.question: 10) Nature has given us an abundant wealth _____ the form of forests.
English Language.exp:
এখানে appropriate preposition হিসাবে in বসবে।
বাক্যের অর্থঃ প্রকৃতি বন রূপে আমাদের অনেক সম্পদ দান করেছেন।

English Language.question: 11) I just had to _____ the orders of my employer.
English Language.exp:
carry on অর্থ চালিয়ে যাওয়া
carry through অর্থ সাহায্য করা 
carry away অর্থ আত্ন সংযম হারানোর কারণ হইয়া
carry out অর্থ পালন করা 
বাক্যের অর্থঃ আমাকে নিয়োগ কর্তার আদেশ পালন করতে হবে।

English Language.question: 12) It was long walk, so malik began moving slowly ____ the town.
English Language.exp: অভিমুখে, দিকে, পানে বুঝাতে preposition  ‘towards’ বসে।

English Language.question: 13) There is no doubt that Afia is very good _____ telling jokes.
English Language.exp:
Good at means skilled at.
In sentence, Afia is skilled at something so 'good at' is the answer

English Language.question: 14) The retired professor decided ____ put ____ ____ a job as an advisor of the central Bank.
English Language.exp: 'Put in for' something means apply for something. So answer is to, in, for.

English Language.question: 15) The government requires ______ before the end of the financial year.
English Language.option1: ক) that these forms should be submitted
English Language.option2: খ) that these forms be submitted
English Language.option3: গ) for these forms to be submitted
English Language.exp:
মূল ক্লজে Requires  থাকায়  subjunctive নিয়ম মানতে হবে। যার মানে Subordinate clause  এর ক্রিয়াটি base form  বসবে।
সুতরাং এখানে that these forms be submitted হবে।

English Language.question: 16) This ship’s restaurant located _____ the sun deck.
English Language.exp:
কোন তলের উপর কোন কোন কিছুর অবস্থান বুঝনোর জন্য preposition ‘on’ বসে, নিচে বুঝালে Under  বসে, মধ্যে বুঝলে in বসে।
এখানে sun deck  বলতে জাহাজের এমন একটি স্থানকে বুঝনো হচ্ছে যেখানে বসে সূর্যের আলো পাওয়া যায় এবং রেস্টুরেন্টের খাবার খাওয়া যায়।

English Language.question: 17) The pet cat jumped _____ the chair.
English Language.exp: jumped off অর্থ লাফ দিয়ে কোনো স্থান  থেকে নামা।  So, the answer is C .

English Language.question: 18) I don’t know as I concur ______ your decision to fire the manager.
English Language.exp:
'Concur in' is followed by the decision or the agreement.
'Concur with' is followed by the person sharing a decision or agreement.
Ex:
1. We concurred in the decision to go ahead with the project.
2. I concurred with the project manager on the decision to go ahead with the project.

তেমনিভাবে,
I don’t know as I concur with your decision to fire the manager.

English Language.question: 19) Kishan is very much fond _____ teaching English .
English Language.exp:
The preposition that goes with ''fond'' is ''of''.
Kishan sir is very much fond of teaching English.

English Language.question: ২০) That child died………..heavy fever.
English Language.exp:
die of (disease): He died of cholera.
die from (effect ): He died from snake bite/ over eating.
die for (shake / cause): He died for his country .
die in ( place / month / year): He died in 1950./ He died in London. / He died in a hospital in Dhaka.
die in (accident ): He died in a train accident.
die on ( name of day /spot death): He died on the spot./ He died on Monday.
die at( time): He died at 9–30 am.
die between ( time): He died between 9 a m to 9–30 am.
die within (time ): He died within five minutes.

That child died of heavy fever.

English Language.question: 21) He was too important ______ any delay.
English Language.exp: TOO + ADJECTIVE/ ADVERB + TO –INFINITIVE. so A is the appropriate answer.

English Language.question: 22) Zahara knows how to swim, ______?
English Language.exp:
This is the example of a Tag question.
Since the main clause is affirmative, the tag question will be negative.
And here, Zahara is third person singular number, So singular form will be applicable.

English Language.question: 23) ______ in the field is feeling sick.
English Language.exp: The Verb ‘is’ takes singular Subject. So ‘one of’ will be the subject and one of takes plural noun.

English Language.question: 24) That was a great match. I will never forget _____ Di Maria score that goal.
English Language.exp:
Verbs like Forget, like, remember, stop etc may take both gerund and infinitive.
Negative sentence  prefer gerund.
So, the correct ans is C.

English Language.question: 25) Her half-brother had her _____ the important assignment.
English Language.exp:
Had is used as a causative verb. subject+ have (any tense)+ object (someone) + verb 1.
Incase of something  the structure will be ‘subject + Have + object (something) + past participle’.

English Language.question: 26) Travelers _____ their reservation well in advance if they want to fly during the eid holidays.
English Language.exp: had better take the base form of the verb.

English Language.question: 27) How long _____ English?
English Language.exp:
An action that started in the past and is continuing in the present indicates present perfect continuous tense.
So, the correct answer is C.

English Language.question: 28) The man _____ my house was a cheat.
English Language.exp:
Who + verb and Whom + subject. So Answer A and D meet the requirement but A do not meet the requirement of tense.
So D is the appropriate answer.

English Language.question: 29) They _______ his failure in the competition.
English Language.option4: ঘ) had been all shocked on
English Language.exp: They were all shocked at his failure in the competition.

English Language.question: 30) Don’t forget to thank your parents for putting ____ with you all these years!
English Language.exp:
'Put up with' means ‘to bear with’ (সহ্য করা).
So the answer is 'up'.
